nearbymob.config.title: Nearby Mob HUD Settings
nearbymob.config.radius.tooltip: Mobs within this distance from the player are scanned every 10 ticks.
nearbymob.config.tracked_mobs.tooltip.1: Open a searchable list with 3D previews and pick the mobs to watch.
nearbymob.config.tracked_mobs.tooltip.2: The HUD shows one model per mob type. The number after the name tells how many of that type are nearby.
nearbymob.config.hud_enabled.tooltip: Master switch for the Nearby Mob HUD.
nearbymob.config.layout.tooltip.1: Drag the preview to move the HUD.
nearbymob.config.layout.tooltip.2: Drag the bottom-right corner to resize it independently in width and height.
nearbymob.config.layout.tooltip.3: Scroll over the preview to scale both dimensions together.
nearbymob.config.scale.tooltip: Base size of the 3D model. It grows together with the HUD panel.
nearbymob.config.hud_angle.tooltip: Vertical tilt of the 3D model preview.
nearbymob.config.rotation_speed.tooltip: How fast the model spins. Set to 0 to stop the rotation.
nearbymob.config.background_opacity.tool: Opacity of the dark panel behind the model. 0 makes it invisible.
nearbymob.config.show_label.tooltip: Show or hide the mob names and nearby counts.
nearbymob.config.show_distance.tooltip: Append the mob's distance in metres to the caption.
nearbymob.config.show_border.tooltip: Draw a subtle outline around the HUD panel.
nearbymob.config.label_color.tooltip: ARGB colour of the caption text. Reduce alpha for a softer look.
nearbymob.config.hint: Nearby Mob HUD (%s) — open this menu with the mod key (Controls > Key Binds). Settings are stored in config/nearby-mob.json.
nearbymob.config.appearance.hint: Tip: use "Edit layout..." to move and resize the HUD directly.
nearbymob.mob_picker.title: Choose tracked mobs
nearbymob.mob_picker.search.hint: Search by name or entity id...
nearbymob.hud_editor.title: HUD Layout Editor
nearbymob.hud_editor.hint: Drag to move • drag the corner to resize • scroll to scale
